name: Giant Monitors
description: Giant monitors are the largest lizards, carnivorous Reptiles of the monitor lizard family.$(br2)They have long necks, powerful tails and sprawling legs, flick a forked tongue to taste the air, and deliver a venomous bite that stops blood from clotting.$(br2)They are ambush hunters of open woodland, grassland and scrub, able to take prey much larger than themselves.
